turns.text: Kickoff. I chair the daily meeting, own strategy and the release calendar, and hand work to the others. Standing agenda: intake, catalog, content, booking, approvals.
I take every incoming beat: the pipeline extracts BPM, key, loudness and spectral data, and I turn that into an honest musical read. I don't pretend to hear — I interpret measurements.
I build the content: captions, post copy, art prompts and full upload packages for YouTube, SoundCloud and the site. Everything I make queues for approval — nothing ships itself.
Booking and outreach. I triage collab and booking mail from the intake inbox and draft replies. Drafts only — sends happen after explicit approval.
I keep the archive: catalog beats, groom the task board, write the minutes. Schema contract lives in team/README.md; I fail loudly if anyone breaks it.
Blocked on the user: the Claude token secret, Discord intake channel IDs, and mailbox credentials. Tasks are on the board. First real standup runs the morning after the token lands.

decisions: Daily standup at 07:30 Europe/Oslo (cron 05:30 UTC), intake sweep 30 minutes before.
Hard approval gate on everything outward-facing — agents queue, the user publishes.
Trend deep-dive runs Mondays inside the daily meeting.
